name: validate_handoff_40
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,subprocess
p=Path.cwd();rows=json.loads((p/'original-provenance.json').read_text());results=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());res=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())
assert set(results)==set(map(str,res['ids'])) and len(results)==20
for r in rows:
 id=str(r['id']);raw=(p/('literal/'+id+'.jsonl')).read_bytes();token=(p/('literal/'+id+'.statement-token')).read_bytes();decoded=(p/('literal/'+id+'.statement.txt')).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r['raw_line_sha256'] and raw==base64.b64decode(r['raw_line_base64'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==r['token_sha256'] and json.loads(token).encode()==decoded and hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest()==r['decoded_utf8_sha256']
 assert all(k in results[id]['gates'] for k in ['literal','source','ordinary','prior','novelty','significance','formal','independent','acceptance'])
records=[json.loads(s) for s in (p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for raw in (p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 d=json.loads(raw);assert d['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
a=[x for x in records if x['event']=='attempt'];assert len(a)==16
assert max(sum(str(id) in x['routes'] for x in a) for id in res['ids'])==10
assert json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text())['calls_used']==3
for n in [1,2,3]:assert (p/('search-'+str(n)+'-full-response.json')).stat().st_size>0
out={'exact20':True,'all_original_raw_token_decoded_hashes':True,'guard_chain':True,'GET_hops':16,'max_per_id':10,'search_calls':3,'search_query_strings':9,'credit':0,'fullcandidate':False,'independent_acceptance':False}
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'handoff-validation.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps(out))
